page.overview:
Who is Abdul Alhazred?

Abdul Alhazred, renowned as the "Mad Sorcerer", was an Arabyan Magician and necromancer from the Arabyan town of Sanaá who travelled throughout the Land of the Dead.

Born to wealthy merchants, Abdul Alhazred was educated alongside the sons of the local caliph. It was in the caliph's private library that Alhazred first learned about the existence of the Land of the Dead from tomes he had been expressly forbidden to read. It was then that he developed an obsessive desire for knowledge of the long-dead civilisation of ancient Nehekhara, and some say it was the dread reputation of this ancient land that drew him to rash acts. Others say it was the calling of the legendary Liche Lord Nagash. None know for certain.

It is said that Alhazred left Araby immediately, stealing enough money to fund his wanderings along with an artefact of such antiquity it was believed to have come from Nehekhara. He has visited the ruined cities of Khemri, Zandri, Numas and Quatar, and over long years plundered them of their secrets. His discoveries rival those of Abdul ben Raschid, whose works he has voraciously studied, and it is these that have sent him spiraling into insanity. Referred to as the "Mad Sorcerer", he is shunned by all except those foolish enough to want to learn the secrets of the Land of the Dead.

Abdul Alhazred has witnessed some of the foulest monstrosities of the Land of the Dead and is quite mad! The mad Arabyan was one of the most learned and powerful Arabyan Magicians in Araby. He knows many spells of Arabyan Elemental Magic and necromancy.
